name: Krasnoyarsk Winter Open 2018
information: Registration will be closed at midnight on January, 30 or when we reach 120 competitors. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Registration fee: * FREE FOR ALL ! If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please contact us to resolve the issue. Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/kwo2018) for more details.
